     estimate of how much data it      
     can safely have in flight. The    
     actual amount sent is limited     
     by the minimum of cwnd and the    
     receiver's advertised window (    
     rwnd), which handles flow         
     control rather than congestion.

     standardized in TCP Reno, uses    
     four phases. In slow start, c
